name: mf_fno_cvblend
description: Control-variate inference blend of two FiLM-on-X FNOs: an HF model (LF-pretrain -> HF-finetune, the winner's pipeline) and an LF-only model (correlated cheap estimator). At inference the blend p = p_hf - beta*(p_lf - E[p_lf]) reduces variance, with the optimal scalar beta* = Cov(p_hf - y, p_lf)/Var(p_lf) fit in closed form on the HF train set (E[p_lf] is the train-set mean LF prediction). extra reports beta, an HF-only vs blend nRMSE ablation, and a control-term-std UQ proxy. Both submodels are the frozen FiLM backbone.
